scope: One synthetic posture; all predeclared cases, primary left seed. Previous B/D/E are external references with different initialization.
gt_usage: GT human shape/body pose/joints are held-out evaluation only. None fitting conditions use no human GT. Known generating cameras used for all fits. Oracle and perturbed use separate head anchors.
evaluation: Absolute camera-space errors without alignment. GT in-frame flags do not test visibility.
